notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Dwarves that don't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and four Dwarves as attackers. Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the four Dwarves. Thorin's first ability triggers four times, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Hellkite Charger and four Dwarves as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers. Holding priority, activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
